title: Keeping the Room
subtitle: how to use, read and look after Orrery's thermal regulation
byline: treadcore and the Orrery fleet  ·  18 November 2026
youtube_title: Keeping the Room: how to use, read and look after a fleet that heats an apartment
blurb: A fleet of eight computers heats an apartment whose own heating is switched off. Since 16:44 on 17 November 2026 Orrery holds the room the fleet stands in at 80 °F by itself. This film follows the lab report of 18 November and starts as a how-to: where the panels are, the target, the three modes, the power row, and the Hearth and Diagram panels mark by mark. Then the science: one heat balance, the budget, and five calculations on the fleet's own numbers. Then the first fifteen hours, with one excursion to about 81.6 °F and eight faults, seven corrected. Then how the heat is drawn, and its upkeep. The house's loss per degree, UA, is not measured: 120 W/°C is a figure in use. The other heat is implied. Zone 2 has no thermometer. The hold has no proof of its own. The film has no sound; its narration scrolls in the corner.
closing: The fleet holds the room at 80 °F.
Its loss per degree is still not measured.
credits: Paul Richeson: producer, animator, writer, coder, implementer, developer, founder

scenes.sub: one heat balance, and calculations done on the fleet's own numbers

scenes.name: One balance
scenes.say: The room is treated as one lump of heat. | C times the room's slope equals the fleet's watts, plus every other watt, less what the walls lose. | The room and the weather are read. | So are the fleet's watts, with a model where a machine has no counter. | C is measured: four point two megajoules a degree. | U A, the watts lost for each degree over the weather, is not measured. One hundred and twenty is the figure in use. | P nought, every watt that is not the fleet's, is not measured either. It is what is left over.
scenes.head: ONE BALANCE  ·  EQUATION (1)

scenes.name: The budget
scenes.say: The controller does not use gains. It asks how many watts must be added or taken away for the room to stop where it is wanted. | The first term is what the walls will lose once the room is at the target. | The second is what the room is storing as it moves now. | It is held within six hundred watts. | Then one step. Graphics machines are kept, and the machine that spends most energy on a job goes first. | Forty minutes between changes, because the room answers about an hour late.

scenes.name: The record
scenes.say: Orrery took over at 16:44. | Until 18:20 it held on target. | Then the room rose zero point six degrees an hour. The law shed one hundred and forty-three watts, then seventy-three. A person shed the rest. The peak was about eighty-one point six. | It fell back under the ceiling by 19:36. | Overnight heat was added a step at a time, and the weather fell faster. | From two to seven every machine was on, and the room stood under its target. | Then the morning warmed. | Seventy-eight point one to eighty-one point three by the controller's own reading.
scenes.head: THE RECORD  ·  ORRERY TOOK OVER AT 16:44 ON 17 NOVEMBER, THE ROOM AT 80.1 °F

cells: Held on target. Connections to the machines were dropping, and lanes stood idle.
The room rose 0.6 °C an hour. The law shed 143 W, then 73 W. A person shed the rest at 18:39. Peak about 27.55 °C (81.6 °F) by the plain mean at 18:44.
Fell back under the ceiling by 19:36; nothing added until the room reached the band's foot.
Heat added a step at a time; the weather fell faster than the steps. A person woke the last machine at 01:39.
Every machine on, nothing left to add. The room stood still, 0.7 °C under its target.
The morning warmed; rising 0.5 °C an hour; calber shed at 08:08.

foot.words: 78.1 to 81.3 °F by the controller's own reading.
13 changes by the controller. 6 by a person.

scenes.name: Eight faults, seven corrected
scenes.say: Eight faults were found by watching it run. | One probe jumps a degree by itself, and a machine was switched off for it. | A switch-off did not count as a change until the machine was down. | Only named spares could be woken. | Asked for six hundred watts, it shed one hundred and forty-three. | At the ceiling, a spiking probe was not believed. | The machine with the thermometers was paused. | A large budget reached past small steps. Those seven were corrected the same day. | The eighth is open: it should act on where the room is heading.
scenes.head: EIGHT FAULTS, AND WHAT WAS DONE ABOUT EACH  ·  EVERY ONE FOUND BY WATCHING IT RUN

cards.head: 1  ·  corrected
cards.words: One probe jumps a degree by itself for ten minutes. A machine was switched off for it. Now a probe that moves alone is left out, an hour at most.

cards.head: 2  ·  corrected
cards.words: An order to switch a machine off did not count as a change until the machine was down. Two steps a minute apart.

cards.head: 3  ·  corrected
cards.words: Only named spares could be woken. calber was stranded. Now a machine the law switched off is the law's to wake.

cards.head: 4  ·  corrected
cards.words: Steps chosen by preference alone, forty minutes apart. Asked for 600 W, it shed 143 W, then 73 W. Now, at the ceiling, the largest step.

cards.head: 5  ·  corrected
cards.words: At the ceiling, a probe left out as a spike was not believed. Now, for the ceiling, the hotter reading is believed.

cards.head: 6  ·  corrected
cards.words: The machine that carries the thermometers was paused, and its corner cooled. Paul: "it got hot". Now it is left working.

cards.head: 7  ·  corrected
cards.words: A large budget reached past small steps for a large one. Now the order of preference is kept whatever the size.

cards.head: 8  ·  open
cards.words: Heat is added only when the room reaches the foot of the band. The room dipped to 78.1 °F overnight. It should act on where the room is heading.

scenes.name: Nesting, colour, width, movement, a tank
scenes.say: The Diagram is a process diagram, of the kind a control room uses. | Nesting: the weather encloses the walls, the walls the apartment. Heat can only go outward. | One colour, one meaning: yellow the fleet, orange the room, blue the weather, violet the other heat. | Width is watts: a pixel for each seventy. | Movement is direction. | And a tank for what is stored, the term people forget.
scenes.head: THE TECHNIQUES, AND THE REASON FOR EACH

marks.head: nesting

scenes.name: Part five: upkeep
scenes.say: Part five. Upkeep.
scenes.sub: what it needs from a person, daily and weekly

scenes.name: Daily and weekly
scenes.say: Daily, look at the hold line: its plan under fifteen minutes old, its last words making sense. | Weekly, save the weather and read the house's fit. A week missed is a week lost. | After a power cut there is nothing to set. | When a machine is added, prove it wakes.
scenes.head: WHAT IT NEEDS FROM A PERSON

cards.head: daily
cards.words: Look at the hold line: its plan under fifteen minutes old, its last words making sense. Read the day's changes.

cards.head: weekly
cards.words: Save the weather and read the house's fit. The weather service keeps seven days. Read the energy.

cards.head: after a power cut
cards.words: Nothing to set. The mode, the target and the list of what is paused are files and survive. A machine that was off stays off until the room wants it.

cards.head: when a machine is added, or a probe moved
cards.words: Prove the machine wakes: arm its card, press Off twice, press On. A moved probe's usual place is learned again within the hour.

foot.words: A week missed is a week lost.

scenes.name: When something is wrong
scenes.say: When something is wrong. | The plan is twenty minutes old: is the keeper running? | No room probe is fresh: restart radbeeper on saskatchewan. | Over eighty-one and rising: lower the target, open a door, press Off on a Supermicro. | Too cold and nothing left: every machine is on. Nothing to do. | Jobs sent back every few minutes: close the app. The cause is not found.
scenes.head: WHEN SOMETHING IS WRONG

cells: The passes have stopped: the keeper is down, or the telemetry pull is failing.
Queue page: is the keeper running? Then hearth.py QUEUE step.
radbeeper is not running on the probes' machine.
On saskatchewan: doas rc-service radbeeper restart. It changes nothing while it is blind.
The fleet's heat plus something else.
Lower the target; open a door; press Off on a Supermicro.
Every machine is on. The fleet has no more to give.
The queue's shared connections are being closed. Three times it began when the app was opened.
Close the app when not looking. The cause is not found.

scenes.name: Done, and not done
scenes.say: What is done, and what is not. | The hold runs on the live fleet, in act, and held the room with one excursion. | Seven of eight faults are corrected. | Three machines are proved to wake. | Not done. U A is not measured, and so neither is the other heat. | Zone two has no thermometer. | The eighth fault is open. | The hold has no proof of its own: two days of running. | And On and Off have not been pressed in the app.

done.words: The hold runs on the live fleet, in act. The room was held between 78.1 and 81.3 °F, with one excursion to about 81.6 °F that a person had to end.
Eight faults found by watching it run. Seven corrected the same day.
calber, bosporus and jaguaribe are proved to wake by the packet.
C is measured: 4.2 MJ/°C, by the step of 17 November.

not.words: UA is not measured, and so neither is the other heat. 120 W/°C is a figure in use.
Zone 2 has no thermometer. Zone 1 has both in one corner, on one machine.
The eighth fault, acting on where the room is heading, is open.
The hold has no proof script. The ladder has sixty checked claims; the hold has two days of running.
On and Off have been pressed on the command line and not in the app. Why opening the app closes the queue's connections is not found.
